verdict.rationale: AnythingLLM ships AI agents, custom agent skills, agent flows and MCP tool use, so per-action approval for dangerous agent actions is a fair question for this product. The evidence pack shows no command allowlists, approval prompts, or opt-in elevated modes. The only related item is 'fine-grained admin controls' over what users can do and see, which is user-permission management rather than gating of agent actions, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As a self-hoster, dangerous actions require my explicit approval — command allowlists, approval prompts, and elevated modes that are opt-in per action
